entries.title: City beneath the heavens
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium desktop wallpaper concept, wide 16:9 landscape, highest available native landscape resolution.
Concept 1 of 3: CITY BENEATH THE HEAVENS. Create an unobstructed panoramic view of Aureline, an inhabited celestial metropolis in the fictional world Meridion. Emotional goal: mystical celestial awe within a believable inhabited world.
Style: hybrid environment art: believable, richly detailed architecture and convincing materials, stylized distinctive architectural silhouettes, strong graphic composition, and cinematic lighting. Refined architectural realism with expressive designed shapes, not a photograph of a real city, not a loose brush painting, not a cartoon.
Scene: layered residential neighborhoods, quietly illuminated transit infrastructure, varied rooflines and a few distant graceful civic spires. The city feels lived in, functional, sophisticated, and culturally specific. Civic architecture blends celestial ceremonial elegance with restrained advanced technology. No generic neon cyberpunk towers.
Composition: broad elevated panorama, city occupying roughly the lower 45 percent and expansive sky above. Skyline with elegant asymmetrical hierarchy and deep atmospheric recession. Central view is expansive and readable; edges have quieter low-contrast detail suitable behind desktop side widgets. Upper 8 percent and bottom 10 percent remain visually calm for menubar and dock. Keep major spires and both moons safely within the central 70 percent so modest widescreen cropping preserves them. No drawn room or window frame.
Light: fixed celestial twilight. Sapphire and deep midnight-blue sky, luminous pearl-white moonlight, scattered warm golden home windows, restrained violet atmospheric haze. Beautiful subtle otherworldly sky, fine stars and thin luminous cloud veils, not an overwhelming busy galaxy poster. Architectural edges catch soft silvery light.
Exactly TWO moons: Radiance is the larger luminous pearl-white moon with a fine silvery coronal aura; Echo is distinctly smaller and dark slate/obsidian, a reflective glassy moon subtly rim-lit against the sky. Both feel integrated into one coherent sky, not two giant planets overwhelming the scene. Do not add extra moon-like discs.
Habitation must be legible through warm windows, neighborhood variation and restrained transit light routes, rather than foreground people. Every building should have coherent structure, purposeful detail and convincing perspective.
Constraints: complete beautiful STILL image; eventual atmosphere animation must not be needed to make it work. No interface chrome, no text, labels, logos, signage, captions, borders, prominent foreground characters, giant decorative constellations, map diagrams or floating HUD graphics. Visual interpretation only, do not assert new named landmarks.
entries.review: Recommended overall: strongest balance of celestial awe, architectural identity, and inhabited depth. Foreground detail merits care around desktop widgets.

entries.title: Across Angel Bay
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium desktop wallpaper concept, wide 16:9 landscape, highest available native landscape resolution.
Concept 2 of 3: ACROSS ANGEL BAY. Create a separate original unobstructed panorama across Angel Bay toward Aureline, the inhabited celestial metropolis of fictional Meridion. Emotional goal: mystical celestial awe within a believable inhabited world.
Visual language: believable richly detailed architecture and convincing stone, glass and metal materials; stylized distinctive silhouettes; strong elegant graphic composition; cinematic light. Refined environment art between architectural realism and expressive stylization. Not a real-world photo, cartoon, loose painting, generic fantasy castle poster or neon cyberpunk.
Scene: viewed across broad calm harbor water from a low distant shoreline. Aureline's varied neighborhoods gather along the far waterfront, smaller warm residential windows establish scale, a few graceful civic spires and luminous domed public buildings emerge from soft violet atmospheric depth. Celestial ceremonial elegance coexists with restrained advanced technology: slender elevated transit structures, discreet luminous connections, plausible piers and bridges. Cream and pale stone with cool metal and glass; warm gold light is habitation, not gold covering every surface. No giant palace dominating the whole city.
Composition: widest and calmest of a three-concept set. Broad horizontal water reflections in the lower third, distant inhabited skyline across the middle-lower band, generous sapphire sky above. A quiet central bay gives breathing room and negative space. Skyline and reflections form a clear restrained graphic silhouette with deep atmospheric recession. Upper 8 percent, bottom 10 percent and side edges should be low contrast enough for OS menubar, dock and side widgets. Main spires and moons comfortably within central 70 percent; no essential subjects on extreme edges. No room, windowframe, foreground people or large boats.
Lighting: fixed celestial twilight, sapphire and midnight blue, pearl-silver celestial light, warm golden window clusters and restrained violet haze. The harbor softly mirrors the sky and warm lights without overbright glitter. Fine stars and thin translucent luminous cloud veils, subtle otherworldly atmosphere, no giant crowded galaxy.
Exactly TWO moons: Radiance, larger luminous pearl-white with a delicate silver coronal aura; Echo, smaller dark slate/obsidian with reflective glassy luster and subtle rim lighting. Place them as a balanced secondary celestial grouping, not giant planets dwarfing the city. Fixed artistic moon presentation, no text or lunar diagram.
Inhabited detail: varied neighborhoods and waterfront infrastructure, a few subdued warm ferry lights in the far distance if needed, but no prominent characters. Coherent architecture, purposeful detail, convincing perspective and reflections.
Constraints: complete beautiful STILL artwork that needs no animation. No generated UI chrome, captions, text, logos, invented signage, borders, map labels, giant constellations or HUD. Interpret established location visually without asserting new named landmarks.
entries.review: Calmest composition and most desktop breathing room. Water reflections introduce some lower-frame contrast; the city feels more distant.

entries.title: Glassline twilight
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium desktop wallpaper concept, wide 16:9 landscape, highest available native landscape resolution.
Concept 3 of 3: GLASSLINE TWILIGHT. A separate original unobstructed metropolitan panorama of the Glassline district of Aureline, in fictional Meridion. Emotional goal: mystical celestial awe in a genuinely inhabited world, emphasizing the everyday neighborhood more closely than a monumental city vista.
Style: believable detailed architecture and material realism, expressive stylized building silhouettes, elegant graphic composition, cinematic lighting. Convincing pale stone, cool metal, clear glass, roofs and residential construction; designed celestial architecture, neither a photograph nor cartoon nor loose painting. Consistent palette of sapphire, pearl, warm gold and restrained violet haze.
Scene: an elevated outdoor view across a lived-in residential metropolitan district. Articulated apartment terraces, modest civic buildings, roof gardens and varied practical residences in foreground and middle distance. A slender elevated transit line gently curves through the district toward distant city spires, with a small subdued illuminated train establishing everyday infrastructure. The transit looks integrated and engineered, not an enormous glowing rollercoaster. Elegant glass canopies and narrow structural ribs suggest Glassline's identity. A few distant civic silhouettes identify Aureline, but the neighborhood is the subject: NOT another giant palace scene. Advanced technology and celestial cultural architecture coexist naturally. Warm inhabited windows and restrained public-space lighting, no overwhelming luminous surfaces. No prominent foreground people.
Composition: broad elevated panorama, relatively closer neighborhood detail in lower half, more distant city recedes into atmospheric depth. The transit curve draws the eye into the scene; preserve a quiet central sky and calm shaded peripheral zones for side widgets and shortcuts. Upper 8 percent and bottom 10 percent should remain subdued for desktop menubar and dock. Main transit structure, distant distinctive skyline and both moons survive moderate widescreen cropping, comfortably away from extreme edges. No drawn room or windowframe.
Sky: fixed celestial twilight, deep sapphire blue and fine stars, pearl moonlight and delicate wisps of luminous cloud with a restrained violet horizon. Exactly TWO moons, balanced within the central sky: Radiance is larger, luminous pearl-white with a delicate silvery aura; Echo is smaller, dark slate/obsidian and reflective glassy, subtly rim-lit. They must feel like moons in this city's sky rather than giant planets or decorative orbs. Do not add extra moon-like objects.
Lighting: cinematic contrast with believable material response, cool pearlescent structural edges, warm golden windows. Atmosphere mystical and expansive but neighborhood feels functional and inhabited. Clear purposeful detail, coherent scale and perspective. No generic neon cyberpunk, no advertising billboards, no magenta neon wash.
Constraints: complete beautiful STILL image, eventual gentle ambient motion optional rather than necessary. No UI, logos, captions, text, invented signage, borders, map marks, HUD graphics or prominent characters. This is a visual interpretation, no new named landmarks or geographic claims.
entries.review: Strongest everyday habitation and transit identity. The detailed left foreground competes more with shortcuts and widgets; a tighter ultrawide crop would lose some street-level detail.
